answer: Each submission hangs on the grove of a task receipt, and the lantern is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the glacier of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
